review_candidates.title: Assistant Manager – Accounting
review_candidates.description: ABOUT CHILDREN INTERNATIONAL Children International Inc., herein referred to as CII, based in Manila and CI-Philippines Inc., herein referred to as CIPI as based in Manila are both affiliates of Children International (CI), a global nonprofit, headquartered in Kansas City, USA, Children International (CI) globally delivers child and youth development programming to break the cycle of generational poverty. Through a long-term, customized approach, we serve young people in 10 countries around the world for the first two decades of their lives. By providing access to resources such as education, health care and positive role models, along with life skills and job skills they need to become sustainably employed adults, we are empowering our participants to improve their own lives, while transforming their families and communities. We are in it for the long haul, because we know that the nearly 220,000 children and youth we support around the world deserve a fighting chance. As a locally registered organization, Children International Inc. (CII) delivers programs that support children and youth across its service areas. With more than 200 staff and over 1,500 volunteers, CII serves nearly 47,000 children and youth across communities in Manila, Quezon City, Caloocan, Malabon and Bulacan; the cities of Legazpi and Tabaco; and the municipalities of Daraga, Malilipot, Santo Domingo and Bacacay in Albay, Bicol Region. CII is also preparing to expand operations into future service areas. Meanwhile, CI-Philippines Inc. (CIPI) is a product-donation organization affiliated with Children International that connects donated health, education, mobility, hygiene and emergency-relief resources with underserved communities and institutions throughout the Philippines. THE CAREER OPPORTUNITY (MORE ABOUT THE ROLE) Children International Inc. is undertaking a significant organizational transition and integration initiative across multiple geographies to strengthen operational effectiveness, service delivery, and long-term impact for children and communities. The organization is implementing a 2 year “Project One CI: Integration, Growth & Sustainability ” to support this transition, and the establishment of a shared services model. This role will provide dedicated accounting leadership and operational support during the implementation, integration, and stabilization of shared service operations across two legal entities: Children International Inc. and CI Philippines Inc. over this two-year period. Reporting to the Senior Manager – Support Services, the Assistant Manager – Accounting is a newly created project role responsible for leading accounting, financial reporting, payroll oversight, compliance, audit preparation, and budget monitoring services for Children International Inc. and CI Philippines Inc. The role helps strengthen and standardize financial processes, controls, reporting practices, and service standards across both legal entities while ensuring continuity of operations throughout the transition project period. Working closely with the Senior Manager – Support Services, the Assistant Manager – Accounting plays a key role in supporting the integration of systems, processes, and ways of working, while providing financial analysis, operational insights, and continuous improvement recommendations that support effective decision-making and the successful implementation of the organization's transformation objectives. As a values-driven leader, the Assistant Manager – Accounting fosters a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture aligned with CI's values. The role supports the engagement, development, and performance of direct reports, builds strong partnerships with stakeholders across both legal entities, and promotes service excellence, continuous improvement, and adherence to organizational policies, including child safeguarding requirements. We are seeking a passionate advocate for children with strong accounting, financial reporting, audit, and compliance experience; sound knowledge of Philippine accounting and regulatory requirements; proven leadership and stakeholder management skills; and a commitment to delivering efficient, compliant, and mission-focused support services that enable lasting impact for children and communities. RESPONSIBILITIES OF THIS ROLE Planning and Organizational Support · In coordination with the Senior Manager – Support Services, support the preparation, and monitoring of annual work plans and budgets for the Shared Services Unit (SSU ) and the two legal entities it supports. · Provide financial analysis and budget information to support planning, forecasting, and resource allocation decisions across both legal entities. · Monitor budget performance and operational expenditures and provide recommendations to the Senior Manager – Support Services on opportunities to improve efficiency, cost effectiveness, and resource utilization across the organizations. Internal Accounting Control · Support the Senior Manager - Support Services in implementing and monitoring internal accounting controls, financial policies, and procedures across both legal entities to ensure consistency, compliance, and effective stewardship of organizational resources. · Review financial transactions and accounting records to verify compliance with established controls, policies, donor requirements, and statutory obligations applicable to each legal entity. · Identify control gaps or compliance risks affecting either organization and escalate findings and recommendations to the Senior Manager- Support Services. Financial Management, Audit Support, Analysis and Reporting · Oversee the day-to-day execution of accounting activities supporting the two legal entities, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant financial processing and reporting. · Oversee the monthly close and key financial accounts reconciliations. · Analyze financial results, expenditure trends, cash flow positions, and budget variances for both organizations and provide recommendations to the Senior Manager – Support Services. · Coordinate the preparation and review of financial reports, management reports, variance analyses, and statutory filings required by agency leadership, regional leadership, headquarters, donors, and regulatory authorities. · Support the Senior Manager- Support Services in ensuring the consistent application of accounting processes, reporting standards, and financial controls across both legal entities. · Coordinate payroll review, processing and related financial activities for both organizations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with organizational and statutory requirements. · Coordinate audit preparations and provide required schedules, documentation, and supporting analyses for internal, external, donor, and statutory audits affecting legal entity. Budget Management · Support the Senior Manager – Support Services in coordinating the annual budgeting process for both legal entities, ensuring compliance with established guidelines and timelines. · Prepare departmental budget, review and analyze budget submissions and forecasts to support informed decision-making and financial stewardship across both organizations. · Prepare budget monitoring reports, variance analyses, and savings recommendations for review by leadership and the Senior Manager – Support Services. · Coordinate with the different department heads for savings and consolidates idle fund savings and proposal for utilization to be submitted to the Senior Manager – Support Services for review and further action Leadership & Development (LPI Aligned) · Recruit, lead, and develop an effective and efficient shared services accounting team. · Manage performance of direct reports through establishing clear accountability, coaching, and development. · Champion a culture of accountability, ethics, service orientation, and continuous improvement. · Lead change and support the direct reports to effectively adapt and integrate to the Child Path model, new operating model and as need in the future to other complex, ever-changing work environments. · Enable a learning culture by ensuring constant learning and capacity building of team members throughout the implementation cycles, as well as partner with global teams and other stakeholders to share best practices and learnings. · Demonstrate behaviors aligned to CI values consistently. · Enable seamless information flow, break down silos, and stimulates effective collaboration across stakeholders within the global organization, agency, external collaborators as well as the community, maximizing collective impact for our children, youth, and families. EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND KEY SKILLS · Bachelor’s degree in accountancy from an accredited institution and Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation required . · 5-7 years of progressive accounting and finance experience covering financial reporting, budgeting, payroll, audit, compliance, internal controls, and management reporting, including at least 1-2 years in a supervisory capacity. · Experience in supporting complex or multi-entity financial operations, including statutory reporting, audit coordination, regulatory compliance, and implementation of audit recommendations and process improvements. · Proficiency in accounting systems and financial reporting tools, with experience in nonprofit, NGO, shared services, or multi-entity environments preferred, and a strong understanding of PFRS and Philippine regulatory requirements, including BIR, SEC, DSWD, and other applicable compliance frameworks. · Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills, proven experience in tactfully building and leveraging partnerships with external and other internal stakeholders (staff and volunteers) as well as demonstrating respectful treatment of others and comfortable working across cultures and diverse environments. · Proven leadership and people skills including recruitment, coaching, performance improvement, and conflict management with the ability to inspire, influence, empower diverse teams and build a culture reflective of CI values and expectations of high performance. · Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and report-writing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, identify trends and improvement opportunities, and clearly communicate insights and recommendations to support effective decision-making. · Tech savvy with proficiency in Excel, familiarity with Dynamics 365 preferred, and/or other digital platforms to support accurate reporting, stakeholder engagement, and data-driven decision-making. · Learning mentality characterized by listening, humility, and openness/courage to change. · Fluency in English and at least one relevant local language with strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Organizational Policies · Strictly observe confidentiality and strong ethics regarding all beneficiary information/financial and other organizational data. · Comply with and ensure adherence to the organization’s policies, safety and security protocols, child safeguarding norms and guidelines by self- and all stakeholders both internal and external. · Promote diversity and inclusion, value other cultures, and demonstrate respect while relating with all organizational constituents irrespective of their race, color, faiths, gender, sexual orientation, age, caste, disabilities, experiences, beliefs, and ethnicity. TRAVEL REQUIREMENT This role is field based and the incumbent has to been comfortable and willing to travel often locally within Philippines to different field sites often (approx. 5-7 days a month). There may also be requirements to travel internationally from time to time. Overall Decision Making & Supervision · Complex decisions requiring independent actions and a high degree of initiative to resolve issues. · This position is monitored on results. Wij starten op 1 januari met het samenwerkingsverband onder de naam Sterk met onze dienstverlening op specialistische ambulante hulpverlening in de regio Amersfoort. Voor jou betekent dit werken bij een ervaren landelijke organisatie (Incluzio) én tegelijk de kans krijgen om lokaal ons samenwerkingsverband Sterk mee op te bouwen. Incluzio heeft zich de afgelopen jaren bewezen in het sociaal domein met stevige processen, een breed netwerk en betrokken collega’s door heel Nederland. Maar in Amersfoort en omgeving begint er iets bijzonders: samen met jouw team bouw je vanaf het begin aan een organisatie die écht van betekenis is voor inwoners. Over Sterk Sterk is een samenwerkingsverband van Incluzio, Abrona en het Leger des Heils in de regio Amersfoort. Samen bieden we specialistische ondersteuning aan inwoners met complexe ondersteuningsvragen. Ook bieden we begeleid wonen. We kijken niet alleen naar de hulpvraag, maar vooral naar de mens daarachter. Vanuit de leefwereld van de inwoner werken we herstelgericht, versterken we talenten en bouwen we samen aan meer zelfstandigheid, eigen regie en maatschappelijke participatie. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat mensen zich gezien, gehoord én sterker voelen. Als Ambulant Begeleider ondersteun je inwoners met complexe en vaak meervoudige problematiek in hun dagelijks leven. Je werkt met inwoners die extra steun nodig hebben om zelfstandig mee te doen in de samenleving en risico lopen om tussen wal en schip te vallen. Je kijkt verder dan de hulpvraag van vandaag en begeleidt inwoners richting meer zelfredzaamheid en regie. Tegelijkertijd werk je nadrukkelijk samen met collega’s, gemeenten en alle zorgpartners in de wijk. De ondersteuning is dus niet alleen individueel, maar juist collectief en netwerkgericht ingericht. Je maakt deel uit van een organisatie in opbouw, waarin samenwerking tussen drie partijen centraal staat. Dit betekent dat je niet alleen uitvoerend werkt, maar ook actief bijdraagt aan het ontwikkelen van werkwijzen, samenwerking en kwaliteit van dienstverlening. Samen met je team draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor de begeleiding van inwoners. Je benut elkaars expertise, stemt af waar nodig en zorgt ervoor dat ondersteuning goed op elkaar aansluit. Hierbij werk je wijkgericht aan het opzetten van collectieven waar dit mogelijk is, maar individueel met de inwoners waar dit nodig is. Wat ga je doen? Je begeleidt inwoners op meerdere leefgebieden; Je werkt intensief samen met de lokale teams, gemeenten, partners in de wijk en collega’s; Je voert intakegesprekken en stelt samen met collega’s zorgplannen op; Je bent (mede) het aanspreekpunt voor inwoners én het betrokken netwerk; Je gaat helpen met de opstart van een nieuwe organisatie en bouwen vanuit de transformatiegedachte; Je bewaakt voortgang en evalueert resultaten gezamenlijk; Je organiseert en neemt deel aan netwerkoverleggen; Je signaleert risico’s en handelt bij crisissituaties – altijd in afstemming; Je ondersteunt het netwerk van de inwoner in de begeleiding; Je draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van werkwijzen en samenwerking binnen het team. Wat je krijgt We creëren een werkomgeving waarin professionals de ruimte krijgen om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, samen te werken en zich te blijven ontwikkelen Je komt te werken in een nieuwe organisatie, maar deze staat niet op zichzelf. Je maakt deel uit van een grotere, landelijke organisatie met een stevige basis. Daardoor heb je toegang tot kennis, ondersteuning en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, terwijl je tegelijkertijd lokaal werkt in een betrokken team waar jouw inbreng direct zichtbaar is. Wie je bent Wij zoeken meerdere collega’s die ervaring hebben in ambulante begeleiding. Ook ben je bekend met netwerkgericht werken en ketensamenwerking. Hierin sta je duidelijk open voor collectief werken, wanneer dit mogelijk is. Verder Zien We Graag Een afgeronde relevante hbo-opleiding Ervaring of affiniteit met complexe en meervoudige problematiek Kennis van het sociaal domein Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op Je neemt initiatief en bewaart overzicht Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende belangen Je bent analytisch en hebt inlevingsvermogen Je bent gemotiveerd om inwoners te ondersteunen bij het vergroten van hun zelfredzaamheid Interesse? Sterk is een samenwerkingsverband van Abrona, Leger des Heils en Incluzio. Je solliciteert bij Incluzio. Door te solliciteren geef je toestemming om je gegevens, indien relevant, te delen met Abrona en Leger des Heils binnen dit samenwerkingsverband. Ons werkgebied omvat de gemeenten Bunschoten, Baarn, Nijkerk, Amersfoort, Leusden, Soest en Woudenberg. Wij vernemen het graag als je een voorkeur hebt voor het werken in een specifieke gemeente en houden hier dan zoveel als mogelijk rekening mee. Our mission is to provide accurate, uncensored news and information to people living in countries where a free press does not exist. We broadcast in nine languages and dialects — Mandarin, Cantonese, Tibetan, Uyghur, Burmese, Vietnamese, Lao, Khmer, and Korean — reaching audiences across China, North Korea, Vietnam, Burma, Cambodia, Laos and beyond via shortwave, satellite, and the internet. Our journalists work in some of the world’s most difficult media environments, often at considerable personal risk, filling a critical gap in access to truthful, timely news for millions of people who would otherwise have very little of it. That reality shapes everything about how we work and who we hire to lead this organization. Job Summary The Visual Editor makes the visual layer of that work strong and consistent across desks — photography, video, graphics, maps, and forensic visuals — so that complex, closed-country stories land with audiences across web, social, and video. Commission, assign, and edit visual coverage for daily news and for projects, partnering with desks and freelancers. Collaborate with OSINT and Data journalists to produce forensic visuals, satellite-imagery analysis, maps, and data graphics. Broad scope and meaningful ownership , spanning clients, operations, commercial performance, people and technology. Direct access to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions across Delivery, Growth, HR, Product and Technology. Room to shape how we operate , as our service models continue to evolve across people, technology and AI.
